Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires are out in the middle and they are followed by the English opening pair of Jos Buttler and Jason Roy. The South African team is seen in a huddle before taking the field. It will be Keshav Maharaj to start off proceedings with the ball for South Africa.
... The Run Chase ...

Jos Butter's decision to bowl first has backfired this time. David Willey came back into the side and had an instant impact with his maiden-wicket over to start the proceedings. But other than him, no other bowler could keep things tight with their spells. except Moeen Ali who just bowled a single over and took a timely wicket to break the second-wicket-stand. Chris Jordan went for more than 50 runs in his spell of 4 while Adil Rashid remained wicketless. David Willey stood out with the ball with three wickets. England batters now have a steep target to chase. Will they be able to win the series? To find out, do stick around for the chase.

It was a clinical batting effort from the visitors. South African batters focused on building stands in the middle and that has helped them to post a huge target. Quinton de Kock fell in the very first over which had the visitors on the back foot. Although, their top-order has been in tremendous form lately and they came up with a great feat yet again. Reeza Hendricks and Rilee Rossouw sticthes a solid stand to stable the ship, with the former going onto rack his third consecutive half-century of the series. Aiden Markram then joined him at the crease and went onto get his 50 as well. David Miller and Tristan Stubbs applied the finishing touches.

A great recovery by South Africa after starting their innings with a wicket-maiden. Their middle-order smacked 64 runs in the final 5 overs to put 191 on the board. England have a huge task ahead of them. Also, the highest ever total chased at this venue in T20Is is 158. So, England have their task cut out.

OUT! CAUGHT! An excellent grab in the deep from Liam Livingstone and David Willey ends the innings with another wicket. Willey goes fuller and bowls it outside off. Tristan Stubbs gets low and launches it high towards the extra cover fence. Livingstone covers a lot of ground from the cover boundary and slides in to take it just inside the ropes. Willey ends with 3 wickets and South Africa finish with 191/5!
Commentary.Howout: c Liam Livingstone b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: Well bowled! Willey rolls his fingers over the ball and bowls it short. This is well outside off and slower too, Stubbs tries to reach it but can't get to it.
FOUR! This is short and around leg stump, Stubbs manages to pull it fine and picks up back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! A length ball on middle, Tristan Stubbs gets a bit low and pummels it straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
Tristan Stubbs comes in at number 6.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! David Willey gets the better of David Miller and sends him packing! Another slower ball, bowled into the pitch and angling into leg stump. Miller backs away and looks to pull but the ball stays low. Miller ends up getting outfoxed by the lack of pace and the unusual bounce as the ball crashes into the leg stump.

Willey starts off the final over with a slower length ball, outside off. The ball bounces a bit extra and Miller is already through the flick. The ball hits the bat and goes towards mid-wicket. Miller gets back for two before the bowler gets to it.
Change. David Willey (3-1-15-1) comes into the attack to bowl the final over.

That will be FIFTY for Aiden Markram, another brilliant kn0ock from him. This is full and on leg stump, Markram clears the front leg and drills it down towards the left of long on for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Smeared away! Length ball, outside off, Aiden Markram backs away and throws his hands at it. Markram ends up slicing it over backward point for yet another boundary. Jordan has now conceded 50 runs with a ball to spare.
On a hard length and well outside off, Miller reaches out and taps it towards sweeper cover for one.
WIDE! An attempted slower ball, spilled well outside the tramline past the off stump.
SIX! BOOM! Another pacy delivery and it is in the slot around middle and leg. David Miller clears the front leg and smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Swing and a miss! Full and close to the off stump, at 145 KPH, Miller looks to go big downtown but gets beaten for pace.
Fullish delivery, at 143 clicks and angling into the pads. Markram heaves it away wide of the man at deep mid-wicket for a single. That should have been two.

LEG BYE! Aiden Markram shuffles right across the stumps and Reece Topley follows him with a full one agin. This time Topley gets it full enough to sneak under the blade. The ball hits the pads and rolls onto the off side as the batters scamper through for a leg bye.
The game of cat and mouse continues. Reece Topley pulls out of his run up twice. He does go through with his delivery on the third go.
Back of a length, slanted across off, Miller taps it towards point for a quick single.

FOUR! David Miller is dealing in only boundaries here! Full and on off, Miller punches it sweetly and beats the man at extra cover. Chris Jordan chases it down and almost pulls it back in but his momentum takes him over the ropes.
This is on a good length and around off, Markram punches it out through covers for a single.
FOUR! Aiden Markram shuffles across the stumps and Topley follows him with a full ball. Markram gets inside the line of the ball and whips it past square leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Aiden Markram makes a reverse scoop look so easy. It si full, around middle. Aiden Markram comes out with a reverse scoop and gets it down to third man fence for a boundary.
Change. Reece Topley (3-0-31-0) is back into the attack now.

FOUR! And again! Short and outside off, Miller gets on top of the bounce and off the back foot, he cuts it in front of point this time. The timing is so good that the ball ends up in the fence in a jiffy.
FOUR! Slapped away! This is short and wide, going across the left-hander. David Miller uses his quick hands and throws them at the ball, crunching it behind point for a boundary.
Full and straight, driven towards wide mid off for a quick single.
David Miller is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Excellent catch from Jos Buttler and the slower ball has done the trick for Chris Jordan. Jordan takes the pace off the ball and drags back his length as well. Reeza Hendricks looks to stay aggressive and swings across the line. Hendricks is way too early in his shot and ends up getting a top edge. The ball goes high in the sky and around short fine leg. The keeper, Jos Buttler runs towards it and dives forward to pouch it safely. Hendricks goes after a brilliant kncok.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: LEG BYE! Pacy delivery, angling on the pads and it is a low full toss. Markram looks to flick it away but the ball goes off the pads and towards backward square leg. The batters get a leg bye.
Jordan gets it really full on off stump, Markram makes room but finds the fielder at extra cover.
FOUR! Crunched! Short ball, over middle, Reeza Hendricks gets on top of the bounce well and muscles it into the sqaure leg fence. 14 off the over, another good one for South Africa.
Well bowled! full and wide, nails the delivery this time and Hendricks can't reach it.

FOUR! Streaky from Reeza Hendricks! A length ball angling just across the off stump, Hendricks has a swipe across the line and gets a thick outside edge that flies over the keeper's head and runs away into the third man fence.
WIDE! Full and wide, just misses the tramline outside off and a wide is called.

FOUR! A gift from Sam Curran and Reeza Hendricks gleefully accepts. This is full and on the pads, Hendricks whips it hard and flat towards fine leg. The ball just bounces in front of the ropes and it will be a boundary.
Very full and wide, Aiden Markram has to reach for it and only manages to play it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Curran starts off from over the wicket and slants it across the right-hander. Markram has a thrash at it but get a bottom edge back onto the deck.
Sam Curran comes back in to replace Adil Rashid who is done with his spell.
Reece Topley sees the batter move to the leg side and follows him with a length ball. Aiden Markram defends it to the off side and crosses.
Low full toss, on middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks works it to long on for one.
FOUR! Top shot! It is a short ball, around off. Reeza Hendricks makes some room and slaps it towards wide long off for a boundary.
Length ball, on the bodyline. Reeza Hendricks flicks it through square leg for a brace.

NOT OUT! Reeza Hendricks is safe and racks up his third consecutive fifty in the series. A risky run this time! Direct throw made it even interesting, but Hendricks was well in. It is a slower short ball, angled down leg. Reeza Hendricks pulls it to deep square leg. The batters call for the second run and push hard. The throws comes in and hits the stumps at the striker's end. The replays show that he is safe.

Is that a run-out? The throw comes in from around fine leg and Jos Buttler just guides the ball back onto the stumps. It is sent upstairs and the replay shows that Reeza Hendricks is comfortably in. NOT OUT!
Reece Topley serves it full, on off. Aiden Markram drives it through covers for a single.
Reece Topley (2-0-20-0) is back into the attack.
Fuller, outside off. Aiden Markram drives it through covers for a single. Adil Rashid ends his spell without a wicket.

FOUR! Aiden Markram gets into the act now. He gets the second boundary of the over. It is full and on off. Aiden Markram gets down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg. It races away. Markram couldn't have hit it any clear.
Rashid drags his length back, on off. Reeza Hendricks pulls it to wide long on for one more.
A single now as this is worked into covers.
Back of a length, on off. Reeza Hendricks stays back and pulls it to wide long on for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Reeza Hendricks is on a roll! It is tossed up, outside off. Reeza Hendricks leans in and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary. He moves to 47.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks moves to the leg side and drills it down to long on for a single.
Fuller, on the pads, Aiden Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Chris Jordan fires it quicker, down leg. Aiden Markram leaves it alone. Wide called.
Back of a length, on the bodyline. Reeza Hendricks pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full length, wide outside off. Aiden Markram slashes it to deep point for a single. 100 up for South Africa.
FOUR! Nicely played! It is short and on off. Aiden Markram stands tall and pulls it into the gap at wide long on for a boundary. This is also the first boundary for South Africa since the Powerplay.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Markram moves to the leg side and clips it through mid-wicket for two runs.
Chris Jordan (1-0-17-0) is back on.
Full, on off. Aiden Markram sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. David Willey keeps it in play with dive and saves a boundary. They take one.
Short one, on off. Reeza Hendricks goes on the back foot and pulls it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, outside off, turns in a touch. Aiden Markram lofts it towards covers but it lands safely. They take one.
Thi is turning into middle and leg, Hendricks tucks it away through mid-wicket for a run.
Floated up full and on off, Aiden Markram gets a big stride out and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
This is from the front of the hand by Rashid, pushed through around off. Hendricks slaps it away past cover-point for a single.
Shorter one, on off. Reeza Hendricks pulls it to long on for one more.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer, on off. Reeza Hendricks leaves it alone. The umpire signals a wide.
Short one, on off. Markram pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full length, angled into the pads. Reeza Hendricks stays back and flicks it past mid on for a single.
A sharp bouncer, on off. Aiden Markram stays back and pulls it towards wide long on for another single.
Curran drags his length back, on off. Reeza Hendricks pulls it to deep square leg for one.
We are back after a short break. Sam Curran serves it on a length, outside off. Aiden Markram punches it to cover for one.

UPDATE 8 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT) - The weather seems to have cleared up and the umpires are out there in the middle Hopefully, the restart is just minutes away. Stay tuned for further updates. The weather is all clear and the umpires are calling the players back on the field.

And, they are off! There has been a constant drizzle over the last few minutes and now it has gotten a lot heavier. The umpires were waiting for the over to complete before signaling the groundstaff to bring on the hovercraft and they have done just that. The players hurry back off the field as well.
A tad short and around off, this is cut away off the back foot towards deep cover for yet another single. At the halfway mark, South Africa are 80/2!
Two more! On off, driven to the right of the man at deep point for a couple of runs.
A touch fuller and on off, Aiden Markram plays it off the back foot and with the turn through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Quicker and flatter, close to the off pole. Hendricks cuts it off the back foot and in front of square on the off side for one more.
Around off, this is driven through mid on for a single.
This is pushed through fuller and outside off, Hendricks gets back to cut a fuller delivery and taps it towards point. They get a single.
Short of a length, around middle, Aiden Markram looks to pull hard but ends up mistiming it well in front of mid-wicket. The batters get a couple of runs.
Firmly hit but just for a run. This is on the shorter side and angling into the body, the ball sits up nicely and Reeza Hendricks pulls it straight towards square leg for one.
WIDE! Short again from Curran but a bit too short this time. This is angled in around middle and leg and Hendricks gets his head out of the way.
This is banged in short by Sam Curran and around off, but it is the cutter as well. Reeza Hendricks sticks out a bat and luckily for him, the ball goes down towards cover-point.
Sam Curran serves it on a length, outside off. Aiden Markram comes across and tries to flick it away but gets it to covers off the leading edge. They cross for one.
Good length, around the hips. Reeza Hendricks pulls it to deep square leg for just a single this time.
Sam Curran starts his spell with a short one on off. Reeza Hendricks pulls it to deep mid-wicket and takes a couple.
Change. Sam Curran comes into the attack now.
On middle, this is driven down to long on for one more.
Nicely flighted, around off and turning away, this is cut away towards backward point.
Here comes the wrong 'un, on a shorter length and around off. Markram plays it off the back foot towards cover for one.
Floats it up, full and around off, this is driven through wide mid off. The batters look for two again but will have to settle for a single.
Tossed up at the stumps, Reeza Hendricks flicks it through mid-wicket for two more.
Adil Rashid starts off with a flighted ball around off, this is played through covers for a couple of runs by Hendricks.
A dot to end an excellent over from Moeen Ali, just 4 runs and a wicket off it. Ali sees Markram and fires it in full. Markram pushes it back to the bowler.
Floats it up on the pads, this is tickled away 'round the corner for a single.
Flatter and around off, this is tapped towards cover-point.
Tossed up around off, Aiden Markram pushes it through mid on for a single.

OUT! TIMBER! An absolute beauty from Moeen Ali to get rid of the dangerman! This is flighted from Ali, drifted nicely into off stump. Rilee Rossouw looks to defend off the front foot and plays for the line. The ball though just turns away a shade, enough to go past the outside edge and hit the top of off stump as well. Ali gets his man and the partnership is broken.
Aiden Markram comes in at number 4.
No wide given! Moeen Ali drifts this one in down leg, Rossouw looks to tickle it fine but it goes off the pads and then off the keeper's pads as well before looping up around leg gully.
Starts off with a flatter delivery, close to the off pole. Reeza Hendricks goes on the back foot and punches it through cover-point for a run.

FOUR! No mercy shown here by Rossouw and 17 runs come off that over. This is full and wide, with some heat behind it as well. Rossouw just thrashes it away past point for a boundary and the 50 comes up as well. At the end of the Powerplay, South Africa are 53/1!
FOUR! Poor delivery from Jordan and he has been hit for a third boundary in the over. Another cross-seamer, full and around off. Rilee Rossouw drives it through extra cover and picks up a boundary.
Good length, around off, Rossouw taps it straight to the man at point.

FOUR! Streaky this time but Rossouw will take it. Length, angling in from around off and Rossouw looks to repeat the trick. This time the ball takes the inside edge and goes past the leg stump, racing away into the fine leg fence.

FOUR! Delicately played! Chris Jordan comes from around the wicket and serves a pacy full ball on off, at 143 clicks. Rilee Rossouw plays it really late and just steers it past backward point for a boundary.
Jordan starts off with a shortish ball around the hips. Reeza Hendricks swivels but mistimes the pull shot towards short fine leg. The batters scamper through for a run.
Chris Jordan to have a bowl now.

LEG BYE! Full length, on the pads, Reeza Hendricks tries to flick but plays all around it. The ball goes to the off side off the pads. The batters collect a leg bye. Another good over for the visitors 8 runs off it.
The rain just played a bit of hide and seek and we are all set for the play to resume. David Willey will finish off his incomplete over as the umpires and the players take their places on the field.

A slight halt in play as Rilee Rossouw is hit on the helmet. There is a bit of a drizzle. The overhead conditions aren't particularly dark but the drizzle is persistent. Oh, wait! As the physio comes out, the umpires have called off the players. The covers are being brought on but it might be a very short delay with clear skies around the ground. Just as the cover comes on, the drizzle seems to have almost dried out and the England players are still hanging around the boundary ropes. And almost instantly, the hovercraft is asked to leave the field and the players will come back on.
FOUR! Off the top edge! Back of a length, around middle. Reeza Hendricks stays back and tries to go for the pull. It goes to fine leg off the top edge for a boundary.
On the pads, this time, Rilee Rossouw stays back and flicks it to square leg for one.
Good length, around off. Reeza Hendricks uses his feet and punches it to point for one more.
Incredible shot! A short ball, outside off. Rilee Rossouw cuts it hard to covers, but straight to the fielder. The fielder fumbles and the batters take one.
Length ball, outside off. Rilee Rossouw tries to chase it but misses.

FOUR! Much better from Reeza Hendricks. It is a full-length ball, angled across, outside off. Reeza Hendricks reaches out and lofts it over extra covers. Two fielders give it a chase but the ball wins the race. 11 runs off the over.
Length ball, on off, flicked to mid-wicket for a quick single.
FOUR! An incredible shot this time! Rilee Rossouw seems to be in decent touch. Back of a length, on off. Rilee Rossouw pulls it powerfully over mid-wicket and finds the boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Hendricks uses his feet this time and gets a fourtunate outside edge down to third man. They take one more.
Reece Topley serves it full, angled in, on off. Rilee Rossouw stays back and pushes it gently towards mid off for one.
Swing and a miss! A full-length ball, outside off. This one flies off the deck. Rilee Rossouw looks to chase it but misses.
On a length, outside off. Hendricks defends it out watchfully.
FOUR! Another forunate boundary for Reeza Hendricks in this innings. It is full, on the stumps. Reeza Hendricks looks to defend it out but gets it to fine leg off the inside edge. It races away.
Good running this time! It is a length ball, outside off. Rilee Rossouw stays back and punches it through the gap at covers. The batters take three with ease.
Good length, on off. Hendricks works it towards mid off and scampers across for a quick single.
Length ball, on off, defended to covers.
BEAUTY! It is a length ball, angled across the right-hander. around off. Reeza Hendricks gets squared up a bit. He gets beaten on his outside edge, not by much to be honest.
FOUR! Up and over! Good length, on off. Rilee Rossouw shuffles across and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full, on the pads, Reeza Hendricks flicks it to mid-wicket for one.

Miscommunication now, but no harm done. It is full, angled down leg. Reeza Hendricks misses his flick and gets it to square leg off the pads. Rilee Rossouw calls for the single but is sent back. He turns quickly and rushes towards the non-striker's end. The throw is wide and Rilee Rossouw is safe.
A length ball, on off. Reeza Hendricks blocks it out solidly.
FOUR! Fortunate boundary for Reeza Hendricks. It is full, on middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks gets it to fine leg off the inside edge. It races away to the boundary.
Full length, on off, pushed to covers.
Reece Topley to steam in from the other end.

NOT OUT! Rilee Rossouw remains at the crease and the review goes in his favour. It is a length ball, around middle, this one holds its line. Rilee Rossouw stays back and tries to block it out but misses. He gets rapped high on high pads/ David Willey appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Jos Buttler takes the review but loses it instead.

Review for lbw! Jos Buttler takes it upstairs. The original decision is not out. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows that the ball is missing the wickets. The on field decision stands.
Length ball, angled across the left-hander. Rilee Rossouw tries to block it out but misses.
Left alone! Good length, outside off, shaping away a touch. Rilee Rossouw leaves it alone for the keeper.
Rilee Rossouw is the new man in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Early success for England. David Willey has an instant impact after coming into the side. It is a good-length ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock stays back and goes for the punch through covers. It takes the inside edge and rattles into the stumps. All the England players are delighted with this wicket. They have their noses in front now.
Touch fuller this time, on off. Quinton de Kock gets on his front foot and defends it off the inner half.
A dot to start with! It is a length ball, on off stump. Quinton de Kock stays inside the crease and blocks it to covers.

The game is set to begin. The England players stride out to the middle. Followed by Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks who walk to open for South Africa. It will be David Willey to start with the new ball. Here we go...

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Reeza Hendricks, Rilee Rossouw, Aiden Markram (In for Heinrich Klaasen), David Miller (C), Tristan Stubbs, Andile Phehlukwayo, Anrich Nortje (In for Kagiso Rabada), Keshav Maharaj, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.

England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jos Buttler (C/WK), Dawid Malan, Jonny Bairstow, Moeen Ali, Liam Livingstone, Sam Curran, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Reece Topley, David Willey (In for Richard Gleeson).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of England. They have opted to BOWL first.

For South Africa though, their new looking top-order has looked dangerous and they need to find the right combinations with the T20 World Cup right around the corner. Will they be able to fit in Aiden Markram and Rassie van der Dussen in this series decider? It looks unlikely with the form their side has been in. The Proteas though have never won a T20I series In England. There is a lot at stake for both the side. Stay tuned for toss and more updates.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third T20I match between England and South Africa. We have seen some outstanding matches throughout this series, but this time around there is a lot on stake as this is the decider with the series level at 1-1. Don't expect nothing less than a thriller.
